title: AICP Workflow DSL
description: Human-authored workflow definition. Parsed into a WorkflowState by the AICP runtime. Supports sequential, parallel, event-driven, and branching flows.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this workflow does

version.description: Semantic version of this workflow definition (e.g. 1.0.0)

context.description: Initial context values available to all steps via ${var} references

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata attached to the workflow

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to execute. Sequential by default; use parallel type for concurrent execution.

on_failure.description: Global failure handler: step ID to jump to if any step fails and has no local on_failure

on_complete.description: Step ID to jump to when all steps have completed successfully (overrides natural terminal)

step.description: A single workflow step. The type field determines which other fields apply.

id.description: Unique identifier for this step within the workflow

type.description: Step type. Defaults to 'capability' when omitted.

name.description: Optional human-readable display name for this step

description.description: Optional description of what this step does

arguments.description: [capability] Static arguments passed to the capability. Values may use ${var} context interpolation.

input_mapping.description: [capability] Map workflow context variables to capability input keys. e.g. {order_id: context.order_id}

output_mapping.description: [capability] Map capability output keys back to workflow context. e.g. {result: steps.confirm.result}

guard.description: Precondition evaluated before this step runs

timeout_ms.description: Max time in milliseconds before this step times out

on_success.description: Step ID to jump to on success. Defaults to the next sequential step.

on_failure.description: Step ID to jump to on failure. Overrides workflow-level on_failure.

on_timeout.description: Step ID to jump to when this step times out

on_approved.description: [approval] Step ID to jump to after approval is granted

on_rejected.description: [approval] Step ID to jump to after approval is rejected

compensation.description: Rollback action to undo this step on downstream failure (saga pattern)

wait_for_event.description: [wait_event] Name of the external event to wait for before proceeding

event_filter.description: [wait_event] Optional key-value filter applied to incoming event payloads

branch_conditions.description: [branch] Ordered list of conditions. First matching branch is taken.

default_branch.description: [branch] Step ID to use when no branch_conditions match

parallel_steps.description: [parallel] Steps to run concurrently. All must complete before proceeding.

parallel_failure_policy.description: [parallel] fail_fast: cancel siblings on first failure. wait_all: run all, collect errors.

subflow_id.description: [subflow] ID of a registered sub-workflow to invoke

subflow_input_mapping.description: [subflow] Map parent context variables to sub-workflow context

subflow_output_mapping.description: [subflow] Map sub-workflow output back to parent context

transform_expression.description: [transform] JSONPath or simple expression to reshape context data

transform_target.description: [transform] Context key to write the transform result into

message.description: [human_task / approval] Message shown to the human reviewer

assigned_to.description: [human_task] Role or user identifier for task assignment

guard.description: Precondition evaluated before a step runs

condition.description: Boolean expression using context variables (e.g. context.items.length > 0)

on_false.description: What to do when condition is false: skip the step, fail the workflow, or branch

branch_target.description: Step ID to branch to when on_false is 'branch'

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of total attempts (including the first)

delay_ms.description: Base delay in milliseconds for fixed/exponential backoff

retry_on.description: Error codes that are retryable. If empty, all failures are retried.

approval_policy.description: Approval gate settings for a step

threshold.description: Risk score threshold above which approval is required (0.0–1.0)

role.description: Role or user group that can approve

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for approval before auto-rejecting

auto_approve_below_threshold.description: Automatically approve if risk score is below threshold

arguments.description: Static arguments for the rollback capability

input_mapping.description: Map context variables to rollback capability inputs

then_step_id.description: Step ID to jump to when condition is true

exit_condition.description: Loop exits when this expression evaluates to true

items_variable.description: Context variable holding a list to iterate over (for-each style)
